verdict.rationale: Blink Shell provides SSH/Mosh terminal access to remote hosts plus file transfer (scp/sftp) and VS Code/Codespaces integration, which would let a developer run git commands on a connected remote machine, but the evidence never explicitly mentions git commit/push or any local git tooling built into the app itself. missing for 10: explicit git command support/documentation, evidence of git workflow usage, independent confirmation that git works well over Blink's SSH sessions.
